SOCECREI.name: Indicator 1.d - Percentage of minority ethnic people who are in ‘Managerial’ or ‘Professional’ occupations
SOCECREI.monitoring:
Monitoring from baseline (2014 - 2021)
The Northern Ireland Census is undertaken every ten years. The 2021 Census was the first one conducted since the baseline year (2014).

In 2021, 26.9% of minority ethnic people were in ‘Managerial’ or ‘Professional’ occupations, compared with 29.0% of white people. Directly comparable figures for this indicator are not available from the 2011 Census.
